title: Module Defect Workbook Row
description: One detailed row per remaining failed test case after heal. Feature is the actual product feature under test (not a tracker alias). Assigned To comes from trackers. Severity and Priority are set once at defect generation from the test execution report (classify-defect-severity-priority.cjs). Sub Module / Frontend Developers / Backend Developers / Dev Status / QA Status are forbidden. Use a single Status column (New, In Progress, Resolved, Reopened, Closed). Only defect-regression may change Resolved to Closed/Reopened on Google; it never changes Severity or Priority. Local Excel is generated first; Google Sheet sync requires explicit human approval and preserves existing Status and Severity/Priority on upsert when already set.

Defect ID.description: DEF-M<milestone>-<Test Case ID>; do not duplicate the module prefix already present in the TC ID.

Feature.description: Functional feature/scenario area within the module (e.g. Page Layout, Search, Sorting, Field Mapping). Do not repeat the module name for every row and never use tracker aliases.

Summary.description: One plain-English sentence naming the module page, the feature, what was being checked, and what went wrong. Simple everyday words only — no Test Case ID, URL, selector, Playwright API name, millisecond timing, or FSD requirement IDs (BR-xxx, NFR-xxx, etc.).

Steps to Reproduce.description: Numbered reproduction steps from Excel when available; otherwise simple navigation + scenario steps using the module page name. Written so a non-technical reader can follow them. Must not contain environment URLs, selectors, FSD requirement IDs, or be only the test title.

Expected Result.description: What should happen, in plain English from the user's point of view. Must not be a generic placeholder or repeat automation terminology.

Actual Result.description: What actually happened, in plain English (e.g. 'The page did not open within 30 seconds'). No ANSI codes, URLs, selectors, raw Playwright call logs, or millisecond values — convert waits to seconds.

Severity.description: Set once when the defect row is generated from the test execution report. Not updated on later Google upserts or regression.

Priority.description: Set once when the defect row is generated from the test execution report (Excel Priority plus execution impact). Not updated on later Google upserts or regression.

Status.description: Single workflow status for the defect. Defaults to New when first raised.
